core_meaning.primary_meaning: Riaz is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Gardens, meadows”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Riaz corresponds to the Arabic form رِيَاض (Arabic root ر و ض (r-w-ḍ); رِيَاض (Riyāḍ)). Its core sense is riaz; gardens, meadows. Riaz is a spelling variant of Arabic رِيَاض (Riyāḍ) 'gardens, meadows', the plural of رَوْضَة (rauḍa). The source gloss 'Frequent rain' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as riyad.
